fields.Name: T126 - Communication Analytics Tour
fields.Description: Opens the Communication app once, then walks its bespoke analytics surfaces (provider cards with capability chips and 24h stats, monitor analytics KPIs/charts, bulk runs timeline), verifying each via checkpoints. Consolidates old T307, T308, T309.

InputDefinition.goal: Using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box), open the Communication app. Then walk these sections IN ORDER, and as you arrive at each one set "checkpointReached" to the exact checkpoint name shown: (1) comm-providers — open the Providers section and confirm provider cards render, each showing capability chips (e.g. Sending and Receiving with check/x marks, possibly Scheduled/Drafts/Forward/Reply), a small stats row (Sent 24h / Success % / Failed), a Status badge (Active/Disabled), and Configure/Analytics footer actions — OR a valid empty state if no providers are configured; (2) comm-monitor — open the Monitor section and confirm the monitor analytics render: a KPI strip with four cards (Total Sent, Delivery Rate %, Pending, Failed), a 'Delivery Volume' time-series chart, a 'Provider Health' list, and a 'Channel Breakdown' — each populated OR showing a valid empty state; (3) comm-runs — open the Bulk Runs (Runs) section and confirm a summary row (Active Runs, Completed 24h, Success Rate %) and a run timeline listing runs with status badges/dots (Complete/Failed/In-Progress/Pending) — OR a 'No communication runs found' empty state — then click the 'Refresh' button and confirm the view reloads and stays functional. Keep going until every section has been visited. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait for content rather than navigating away.

checkpoints.name: comm-providers
checkpoints.instruction: provider cards with capabilities and 24h stats
visualCriteria: Provider cards render with capability chips and a 24h stats row (Sent / Success % / Failed), each with a Status badge and Configure/Analytics footer buttons — OR a valid empty state if no providers are configured

checkpoints.name: comm-monitor
visualCriteria: The Monitor analytics render a KPI strip of four metric cards (Total Sent, Delivery Rate %, Pending, Failed) plus a 'Delivery Volume' chart, a 'Provider Health' list, and a 'Channel Breakdown' — each populated or a valid empty state (zeros acceptable)

checkpoints.name: comm-runs
visualCriteria: The Bulk Runs view renders a summary row (Active Runs, Completed 24h, Success Rate %) and a run timeline with status badges/dots — OR a valid 'No communication runs found' empty state — and clicking Refresh reloads the view without error
